question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql: SELECT AVG(new_companies) as average_new_companies_per_year FROM (SELECT cd.year_founded, COUNT(*) as new_companies FROM companies_funding cf JOIN companies_industries ci ON cf.company_id = ci.company_id JOIN companies_dates cd ON cf.company_id = cd.company_id WHERE ci.industry = 'Fintech' AND cd.year_founded IN (2019, 2020, 2021) GROUP BY cd.year_founded)
